name: Curtiss-Wright Corporation
blurb: Curtiss-Wright Corporation provides engineered products, solutions, and services to aerospace and defense, commercial nuclear power, process, and industrial markets worldwide. It operates through three segments: Aerospace & Industrial, Defense Electronics, and Naval & Power. Founded in 1929, the company is a diversified industrial manufacturer with a strong presence in defense and nuclear markets.
